text:
maya: Heads-up — PR #3284 swaps a handful of terms across the quickstart and SDK snippets (create -> send, modelId -> model). I want a quick alignment on voice + a tiny migration note before we merge.
sam: can you drop the PR link and a short diff? easier to triage that way.
maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3284 — main changes are under /sdk/js and /quickstart. Example: in JS snippets we changed `client.createCompletion()` to `client.send()` and updated param `modelId` -> `model`.
leo: prefer `send` as the verb but we should be consistent: SDK method names vs docs verbs. Do we want prose to say "call send" or "invoke the send method"? small but matters for tone.
natalie: my vote: keep imperative, short. e.g., "Call client.send(...) to generate text." That maps cleanly to code snippets.
vic: also note capitalization: some pages currently have "Dedicated" capitalized in headings and others lowercase. Might need a glossary entry for product names and deploy modes.
priya: I can run a codemod to update snippets if we agree on terms. regex I'd use: search `createCompletion\(|create_chat\(` -> replace with `send(`. also update param `modelId:` -> `model:` in codeblocks.
maya: +1 for codemod. Can you also output a list of changed files so we can add to the PR description?
priya: yep, will run and paste results in this thread in ~30m.
docs-bot: link-checker: found 3 broken internal links in the PR diff: /api/old-create -> 404, /sdk/v0/create -> 404, /guides/migration-old-methods -> 404.
sam: those links should be updated to the new paths; maybe add redirects if repos config allows. We should avoid merge until link-checker is clean.
leo: For the migration note: keep it short, 2 bullets: what changed (method and param names), code example showing old->new, and a note about backing compat (if any).
natalie: also add a one-line note in the quickstart header: "Updated SDK method names in 2026-03; if you use pinned older SDKs see migration guide."
vic: I'll add the glossary stub: entry key `send (SDK)` with canonical phrasing and cross-ref to method. Also adding "Dedicated" product name as capitalized in glossary so writers follow it.
maya: action list: priya runs codemod + comment with file list; vic adds glossary entries; leo drafts migration bullets and old->new snippet; natalie updates quickstart header and does a pass for tone; sam will hold merge until docs-bot link-check passes.
priya: started the codemod, output so far: changed 12 files under /sdk/js and 5 quickstart snippets. Pasting few paths: `/sdk/js/quickstart.md`, `/sdk/js/examples/chat.md`, `/quickstart/index.md`. Full list in PR comment.
sam: thanks — once PR comment is updated I'll re-run the link-checker.
maya: ok team, timeline? can we aim to merge today if all green?
leo: I can get the migration snippet done in 45m.
vic: glossary entry done in 20m.
natalie: quickstart header update done, will do tone sweep after leo posts snippet.
priya: codemod complete, pushed a follow-up commit and added file list. ran unit tests for doc build locally.
docs-bot: link-checker: all links passed on latest commit.
sam: cool — I'm going to approve once leo's migration bullets are in the PR description.
maya: thanks everyone — please add any small wording suggestions as inline comments. I will merge after sam approves. :thumbsup:
